## Argentina GDP Per Capita (1960-2025)

##### Argentina GDP per capita for 2025 was $14,898, a 6.65% increase from 2024.

- Argentina GDP per capita for 2024 was $13,970, a 2.05% decline from 2023.
- Argentina GDP per capita for 2023 was $14,262, a 2.15% increase from 2022.
- Argentina GDP per capita for 2022 was $13,962, a 30.03% increase from 2021.

GDP per capita is gross domestic product divided by midyear population. GDP is the sum of gross value added by all resident producers in the economy plus any product taxes and minus any subsidies not included in the value of the products. It is calculated without making deductions for depreciation of fabricated assets or for depletion and degradation of natural resources. Data are in current U.S. dollars. The full historical dataset is available for download here: Argentina GDP Per Capita | Historical Data | 1960 - 2025.
